lines.text: WARDEN: Fits uh dithastuh!\c\nHai lofs ma teef en thu thee.\nPhlease thelp fwee!
Ah’m howteen ohn hoo!\nThearch rute nintheen!
Hwat?\nIhm houhing hon hyou!
You gave the Gold Teeth to the warden.
The warden popped in his teeth!

WARDEN: Yuck!
They’re all sandy and gritty!\c
...Anyway. Thanks, sonny!
You’re a real lifesaver!\c
No one could understand a word that I said—
not a one!\c
I was too ashamed to show my face around
the office, even.\c
Let me give you something for your trouble.

WARDEN: Yuck!
They’re all sandy and gritty!\c
...Anyway. Thanks, lassie!
You’re a real lifesaver!\c
No one could understand a word that I said—
not a one!\c
I was too ashamed to show my face around
the office, even.\c
Let me give you something for your trouble.
You got a [VAR COLOR(0006)]Safari Set [VAR COLOR(0000)]from the warden!
You put the [VAR COLOR(0006)]Safari Set[VAR COLOR(0000)] in your Clothing Trunk!
And here...\c\nI’ll teach you something neat!\nA [VAR COLOR(0006)]Secret Technique[VAR COLOR(0000)] called [VAR COLOR(0006)]Strong Push[VAR COLOR(0000)]!
What’s this, sonny? You’d rather have your\nPokémon learn the Secret Technique?
Well I suppose it makes no difference to me!\nNow come this way and have a look.
What’s this, lassie? You’d rather have your\nPokémon learn the Secret Technique?

You sometimes find big blocks like this one in
caves and other such places, right?\c
You can push them around if you take a moment
to gather up your strength first!

The trick is this...\c
Hrrrkh! You grit your teeth as hard as you can!
...If you’ve got ’em...\c
Then all at once, just let ’er rip!
Hyah!
[VAR PKNICK(0003)] learned the [VAR COLOR(0006)]Secret Technique[VAR COLOR(0000)]\n[VAR COLOR(0006)]Strong Push[VAR COLOR(0000)]!
Hooey!\nLook at that, learning Strong Push in just one go!\c\nYour [VAR POKNAME(0002)] is a clever one, sonny!
Hooey!\nLook at that, learning Strong Push in just one go!\c\nYour [VAR POKNAME(0002)] is a clever one, lassie!
Just keep on pushing your way ahead, in battle,\nin life, or in anything!
